info.title: API.SH: Shopify App Store
info.description: The Shopify App Store API from API.SH: public Shopify App Store data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Shopify App Store app: name, developer, description, icon, rating, review count and star breakdown, Built for Shopify, pricing summary and every plan with price and features, based-in country, awards, highlights, languages, works-with integrations, categories, developer address and support email, launch date, demo store and the AI review summary.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shopify-apps-app

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: App handle (the part after apps.shopify.com/).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: App link instead of handle.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Shopify App Store category: name, tagline, app count, its subcategories and its apps (handle, name, link, icon, rating, review count, pricing summary, tagline, Built for Shopify badge, sponsored flag and position), 24 a page, with sort, works-with and Built for Shopify filters. Top-level categories are curated landing pages: they return their subcategories and featured apps, and paging, sort and filters work on their subcategories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shopify-apps-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug (from apps.shopify.com/categories/<slug>, or a subcategory slug from this route), or the category URL.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: works_with
parameters.description: checkout, customer-account or point-of-sale, comma separated.

parameters.name: built_for_shopify
parameters.description: true for Built for Shopify apps only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
